page.layout: Two printed columns on one page, divided by a vertical rule. Left column first, then right column. Running head at top, page number 329 at top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: נְשִׂיא, constr. נְשִׂיא princeps, נְשִׂיאִים principes, נְשִׂיאֵיהֶם illorum, נְשִׂיאָה ejus, נְשִׂיאַי mei, &c. No. sing. & pl. m. aff. Rad. נָשָׂא levare.
נָשִׁיב reducemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. שׁוּב.
נְשִׁיָּה oblivio, No. f. fœm. Rad. נָשָׁה oblitus est.
נְשֵׁיהֶם uxores eorum, נְשֵׁיךָ ejus; נְשֵׁיךָ tuæ, &c. No. pl. fœm. aff. Rad. נָשָׁה.
נִשְׁכִּי, נִשְׁיֶךָ debitum tuum, No. f. m. נֶשִׁי, aff. Rad. נָשָׁה oblitus est.
נָשִׁים mulieres, No. pl. fœm. R. נָשָׁה.
נַשְׁמָה ponemus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. parag. Rad. שׂוּם.
נַשִׁים desolabimus, Num. 21. 30. pro נָשִׁים, vel נְשִׁים; fut. Hiph. 1. pl. Rad. שָׁמַם.
נָשִׁים exstirpabimus eos, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. aff. (qu. à 3. sing. m. יַשִּׁיא exactorem aget, Ps. 55. 16. pro יִשַּׁח;) Rad. נָשַׁח.
נָשִׁים mutuantes, Ben. Kal, pl. m. à f. m. נָשָׁה; Rad. נָשָׁה.
נְשִׁינוּ mulieres nostræ, No. pl. fœm. נָשִׁים, aff. Rad. נָשָׁה oblitus est.
נְשִׁיקָה osculum, נְשִׁיקוֹת osculæ, No. f. & pl. f. Rad. נָשַׁק osculatus est.
נְשִׁירָה cantabimus, fut. Hiph. 1. plur. parag. Rad. שִׁיר.
נָשִׁישׁ gaudebimus, fut. Hiph. 1. pl. R. שׂוּשׂ.
נָשֵׁךְ mordens, נָשֶׁךְ usura, Ben. Kal, & No. f. m. Rad. נָשַׁךְ momordit.
נִשְׁכְּבָה cubabimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. parag. Rad. שָׁכַב.
נִשְׁכָּה cubiculum, (idem quod לִשְׁכָּה) No. sing. fœm. Rad. נָשַׁךְ mo-

page.notes: Running head and Hebrew letters in the headers are uncertain. Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks in several entries are hard to read at this scan size and may be imprecise; the consonantal forms are the best reading. Entry "נָשִׁים exstirpabimus eos" runs over the column break and is joined into one paragraph. The first word "fut." at the top left is partly obscured by ink. The entry at the foot of the right column ends at "mo-" with the catchword "mordit", which is the continuation.
